rationale: Describes session replay, product analytics and error tracking that help software teams diagnose issues and review product analytics; these are conventional observability and analytics functions, with no AI claim.
evidence_spans: LogRocket combines session replay, product analytics, and error tracking – empowering software teams to create the ideal product experience.
Software teams can fix user-reported issues faster, de-noise their error alerts, and see the "why" behind their product analytics graphs and funnels.
